fixture.title: Nike — reference components
fixture.description:
Reference fixture for design-systems/nike. Monochromatic UI
        (black / white / grey only), massive uppercase Nike Futura ND display
        type at 96px / 0.90 line-height, pill-shaped buttons (30px radius),
        zero card shadows. Just keep going.

selectors: /* `.eyebrow` — small uppercase label above section heads. The only place Nike pushes positive tracking (uppercase needs the breathing room); display copy below uses negative tracking. */ .eyebrow
/* `.swoosh` — a stylized swoosh divider rule that anchors the hero. Pure CSS
/* h3 — card title at the body baseline
/* ─── Promo bar — Nike's signature dark band atop every page ─ §4: "Top banner: promotional message bar with dark background (#111111) and white text"

/* ─── Typography ───────────────────────────────────────────── Nike's display layer is uppercase Nike Futura ND at 96px with 0.90 line-height — the "stadium scoreboard" §3 calls for. Below the display layer
Helvetica Now (body) handles everything at weight 500 (the brand's documented dominant weight for interactive copy). */ h1
Helvetica Now Display Medium tier (the second slot in --font-display falls onto it when Futura ND is absent). Title-case
NO shadow ─────────────── §6 — "Nike's elevation philosophy is radically flat. There are no card shadows
and the focus ring is the documented blue 2px halo. */ .field
ascenders nearly touch descenders. Nike Futura ND below 24px is forbidden (§7)
border-active darkens to Nike Black on focus
just a visual nod to the brand's geometric language. */ .swoosh

kbd ───────────── §4 nav: "text color shifts to Grey-500 (#707072)" on hover. No blue inline links here — Nike keeps reading copy monochrome and reserves --focus-ring blue for keyboard focus alone. */ a

monochrome only ─────────────── Nike's pill (30px radius) is the SOLE button silhouette across the whole brand (§4). Primary uses --accent (Nike Black) with the hover shifting to grey-500 — the documented behaviour
no floating elements." Cards differentiate from --bg by sitting on --surface
not a darken. Secondary is the 1.5px outlined variant from §4. */ .btn
so h1 is the ONLY place this size and treatment appear. */ h1
soft hairline ─────────────────────── §4 — non-search inputs use grey-100 fill
with a 20px (--radius-md) corner for "interactive containers" per §5. */ .card
